newsitem.title: USA: Winnebago says Q1 profit boosted by sale.
newsitem.headline: Winnebago says Q1 profit boosted by sale.

text.p: Winnebago Industries Inc said Thursday the sale of its Cycle-Sat division boosted net earnings to $19.2 million in the first quarter, up from $2.9 million one year ago.

The company said without the $16.5 million gain from the Cycle-Sat sale, net income would have totaled $2.7 million. Revenues in the period reached $113.9 million, little changed from the $113.7 million in the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
Winnebago, which makes motor homes for leisure travel, said it was able to achieve slightly higher revenues even though there was one less week in the most recent period.
Winnebago stock closed down 1/8 Thursday at 7-1/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.
